lessons_used: Deferring account sign-in after pet selection significantly harmed performance (-7.3%), making the predicted +15.0% gain far too high.
Redesigning the home intro with an interactive checklist showed no clear effect, so the +10.0% prediction was too high.
Spotlight layout changes for path selection yielded no clear effect, and the +8.0% prediction was too high.
Adding desktop overlay hints resulted in no clear effect, with predictions (+5.0%) being too high.
Predictions were consistently too high across all onboarding A/B tests.

candidates.title: Split Screen Account Verification & Sign In Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the sign_in screen into a split layout clearly distinguishing returning pet parents from new users with explicit sign-in options to prevent accidental account resets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, and 2 emails reported sign-in stalling or failing.

sign_in.headline: Welcome Back or Create Your Pet Account
sign_in.body: Sign in to keep your pet save state safely synced across your devices.

sign_in_options.text: Select your account method to preserve existing pet profiles.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[1]': nothing on the sign-in screen may lead past it without signing in

candidates.title: Move Account Sign In Before Path Selection
candidates.change: Reorders onboarding to place sign_in immediately after the initial story screen, securing user account state before path or pet customization choices.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets cited reset/missing pets when signing in later; establishing the account prior to path selection ensures choices attach directly to the user profile.

sign_in.headline: Sign In First to Save Progress
sign_in.body: Secure your profile so your pet and customizations are always preserved.

guard.reason: sign_in may move later, not before choose_path

candidates.title: Guided Multi-Angle Pet Generation Validation Flow
candidates.change: Inserts a model validation screen 'new_photo_validator' between upload_photos and adoption_certificate to check photo quality before generation begins.
candidates.why: Adoption step has a low conversion rate (60.9%) and long completion times (mean 1017s), alongside 3 support emails reporting failed custom pet generation or bad model outputs.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Pet Photos
upload_photos.hint: Use clear lighting and clear angles for best 3D pet generation results.

new_photo_validator.headline: Review Pet Generation Quality
new_photo_validator.body: Checking image lighting and framing to ensure your pet renders correctly on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a photo quality validation screen inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses major funnel bottleneck (39.1% drop) and 3 support emails, but requires a new validation screen flow.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Personalization Badge
candidates.change: Adds an official verified pet parent badge visual component to the adoption certificate screen to celebrate completing pet creation.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is the lowest in the funnel at 60.9%; adding visual accomplishment feedback encourages users to move past certificate confirmation.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your pet is officially registered! Name your companion to finalize adoption.

guard.reason: Adding a badge component retains official certificate functionality.

candidates.score_note: Targets low adoption conversion (60.9%), though evidence comes only from funnel metrics without support email validation.

candidates.title: Real-time Pet Generation Stage Progress Tracker
candidates.change: Replaces the generic wait status on the waiting screen with step-by-step progress text, dynamic timer estimate, and progress bar.
candidates.why: The waiting screen (home step) has a median completion time of 201s and a mean of 2336s, causing uncertainty and drop-off during generation.

wait_status.text: Generating 3D model mesh and desktop animations...

guard.reason: Real-time wait dynamic progress tracker is allowed on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extremely high wait duration on home screen; supported by duration data but lacks support mail signals.

candidates.title: Background Rendering System Notification Alert
candidates.change: Enables system notification opt-in and extended tip delays on the waiting screen so users can safely minimize the app during pet generation.
candidates.why: Mean waiting time in home step is extremely long (2336s), suggesting users switch to other tasks and forget to return to the application.

waiting.hint: You can safely minimize this window. We will send a desktop notification when your pet is ready!

guard.reason: Background notification opt-in and hint adjustments are permitted on the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Helps retention during 2336s mean render wait via system notifications; funnel duration evidence only.

candidates.title: Live Desktop Render Diagnostic Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new screen 'new_render_check' before home_intro that verifies desktop graphics overlay compatibility and display positioning.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported that pets fail to show up on the desktop screen or the app fails to open after waiting.

new_render_check.headline: Desktop Display Verification
new_render_check.body: Testing desktop overlay permissions and pet screen positioning.

guard.reason: Adding a desktop render check screen within onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Directly resolves 3 desktop render support tickets and long home wait times, but requires building a new diagnostic screen.

candidates.title: Stage Layout Redesign for Home Intro Screen
candidates.change: Redesigns the home_intro screen into a stage layout featuring a prominent animated pet preview and action button to start desktop interaction.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% with an average time of 5815s; a focused stage layout accelerates progression onto the active desktop.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Your pet is ready and exploring your desktop screen right now!

home_welcome.text: Your companion will wander around your screen. Click or right-click anytime to interact!

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a preview cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Desktop Controls & Tray Access Callout Hint
candidates.change: Adds explicit instructions on the home_intro screen on how to access pet controls via system tray or right-clicking the desktop mascot.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets detailed post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Active!
home_intro.hint: Right-click your pet on screen or click the tray icon to chat, customize, hide, or open settings.

guard.reason: Adding tray and control callout hints to home intro is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Backed by 3 support tickets and lower finish conversion (64.8%), though hint interventions historically show low lift.

candidates.title: Clear Path Outcome Copy Optimization
candidates.change: Updates headlines and body copy on choose_path screen to explicitly detail the exact difference between choosing presets vs custom photo generation.
candidates.why: choose_path step conversion is 76.2% with a long mean duration of 514s, indicating uncertainty about what each path selection implies.

choose_path.headline: How Would You Like to Create Your Pet?
choose_path.body: Select 'Instant Pet' to choose from ready-made companions, or 'Custom Pet' to generate a companion from your own pet photos.

guard.reason: Copy optimization clearly presents both path options without mentioning pricing.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy change targeting choose_path drop-off and duration; past path changes showed slight negative lift.

picked: Desktop Controls & Tray Access Callout Hint

decisions.title: Desktop Controls & Tray Access Callout Hint

lessons_next: Adding a custom pet generation status indicator was helpful (+14.7% measured), and the prediction (+14.0%) was slightly too low.
Deferring account sign-in after pet selection significantly harmed performance (-7.3%), and the prediction (+15.0%) was far too high.
Path outcome copy optimization significantly harmed performance (-6.6%), and the prediction (+1.5%) was too high.
Desktop hints and callout overlays showed no clear effect; predictions (+2.5% to +5.0%) were too high.
Home intro redesigns (interactive checklist) and path layout changes (spotlight layout) showed no clear effect, and predictions (+8.0% to +10.0%) were too high.
